author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Microsoft 365 users who have been curious about Claude Cowork now have their own powerful AI project management system – Copilot Cowork.

This video shows how to set up Copilot Cowork and design a project. You'll learn how Cowork can manage multiple steps and execute different types of tasks in a real-world scenario, like planning an event or scheduling detailed weekly briefings. 

This video also introduces Copilot Actions, which enable Copilot to send emails and meeting invitations directly from the Copilot Chat. Actions can be used as a powerful new feature in the core Copilot Chat, but they are also a vital component for enabling complex projects in Copilot Cowork.
